scope: Public 50-MLP split of the Phase 1 test set; private 50 sealed

claim: The archive in arc_whitebox/submissions/production_baseline_320802/ is the estimator behind submission 320802.
scope: Frozen re-package cut 2026-07-30 from the T0 grader-instrumentation bundle
evidence_boundary: Identified by matching the recorded operating point (adjusted 1.55e-7, raw 2.416e-7, effective compute 1.745e11), not by byte comparison with the uploaded tarball. AIcrowd holds the authoritative upload.

claim: Replacing dense propagation with the tracked depth-5 Winograd kernel improved adjusted score 1.5412x at unchanged statistical design.
scope: Exposed Mini-100, 100 networks, zero failures, both arms
evidence_boundary: Same 66048-point design and output rows; the gain is charged-cost reduction, not accuracy. Cohort differs from the graded AIcrowd cohort.

claim: Layers 1 to 30 are returned as zeros; only layer 0 and layer 31 carry estimates.
evidence_boundary: Deliberate choice against the scored final-layer objective; it is why all-layers MSE sits near 0.74.

claim: Complete Kerdock is within 0.0233242% of the nonnegative static-rule infimum.
scope: Dimension 256; depth-32 limiting normalized-ReLU kernel; static network-independent linear cubature; at most 66048 nodes; nonnegative mass-one weights
evidence_boundary: Conditional on the certified interval stack; independent interval reconstruction and human proof review remain open.

claim: The audited signed frozen-witness result caps Kerdock-relative risk reduction at about 6.294%.
scope: Same static limiting class and fixed node budget
evidence_boundary: Not an equal-FLOPs or equal-wall-time result.

claim: For a known-mean anchor and independent complete blocks, the estimator variance is block residual variance divided by the number of blocks.
scope: Independent sampled complete blocks with a known anchor expectation
evidence_boundary: Do not substitute rowwise residual variance.
